Vegetable garden calendar

Your crops with your own dates: sowing under cover, sowing outdoors, planting out and harvest windows, by fortnight, shifted by a number of weeks you set for your area. What to sow, plant and harvest this week, a printable 12-month timeline, crop rotation checked bed by bed (same botanical family in the same place last year), a journal of sowings and harvests with weights, and a season report. A list of 60 vegetables with their botanical family to start with; no sowing dates or companion planting lists are supplied, because no reusable source could be verified. No weather service.
